version.changelog:
- Operate Checkly through the OOMOL-connected `oo` CLI.
- Retrieve individual checks, results, statuses, and account details.
- List checks with optional type, tag, status, and search filters.
- List recent results and current statuses for Checkly checks.
- Uses live action schemas and server-side credentials for safe, contract-driven requests.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@75bac03`

llm.summary: This Checkly skill is mostly coherent and read-oriented, but its fallback setup includes high-trust authentication and an unverified remote installer path that users should review before installing.

dimensions.detail: Runtime authority is declared as Bash(oo *), which is proportionate for the normal workflow and would not directly permit the curl or PowerShell installer command if enforced, but it does permit oo auth login and connector runs.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The first-time setup section tells users to install the oo CLI with curl-to-bash or PowerShell irm-to-iex from cli.oomol.com, without a pinned version, checksum, signature verification, or explicit approval language.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The description routes any Checkly request to this skill, which is broad, but the actual listed Checkly operations are limited to reads; setup instructions are separated as first-time fallback steps.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill has no bundled persistence or background worker, but one-time setup can change local OOMOL login state and external Checkly account connection state after an auth or connection failure.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The main capability is purpose-aligned: it uses the oo CLI to inspect Checkly action schemas and run listed Checkly get/list/status actions, all of which are read-only in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using OOMOL as the credential broker for Checkly. Do not run the documented remote installer casually; prefer a verified or package-manager install path for the oo CLI, and treat oo auth login plus Checkly connection setup as explicit account-changing steps. Normal Checkly get/list/status actions appear read-only.
llm.findings:
[SC2] expected: Accepted as a material concern: installing a prerequisite CLI is related to the skill, but the documented pipe-to-shell installer is high-trust and unverified.
[SDI-1] expected: Partially accepted: the skill is primarily read-only, but fallback login and connection setup can modify auth/account state and should be treated separately from reads.
[SQP-1] expected: Downgraded: broad Checkly routing is imprecise, but the artifact’s operational action list is read-only and does not show hidden unrelated capabilities.
[SDI-4] expected: Partially accepted: the safety section correctly labels listed connector actions, but it does not explicitly classify installer, login, and account-connection setup as high-trust state-changing steps.
[T03] expected: Accepted as overlapping evidence for the installer concern; there is no evidence the hosted installer is malicious, but the artifact documents immediate execution of mutable remote code.
